captions.detailed: A commercial kitchen exhaust box fan featuring a square-profile housing in a metallic gray finish. The front opening reveals a black, backward-curved six-blade impeller protected by a black wire safety guard. On the right side of the housing, a black control panel is mounted with a red, cylindrical three-position dial knob. The impeller is mounted on a central revolute axle allowing continuous spinning, while the dial knob is on a separate revolute joint for switching positions.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a commercial kitchen exhaust box fan. It should feature a square housing box, a wire safety grid on the front, a central backward-curved 6-blade impeller on a continuous revolute joint, and a side-mounted control panel with a red 3-position rotary dial on a revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main housing using a hollowed-out box primitive. Create the wire guard by intersecting arrayed cylinders or wires. Model the impeller with a central cylinder hub and six curved blades extruded along helical or curved sketch paths. Model the side control panel using a thin plate and a cylindrical dial knob. Define two revolute joints: one continuous joint for the central impeller axle, and one limited-angle revolute joint for the side-mounted dial knob.
